nodes.description: HAX1 is a direct partner and stimulatory cofactor of CLPB and depends on it for solubility. HAX1 deficiency itself causes severe congenital neutropenia (Kostmann syndrome), which links CLPB dysfunction to the neutrophil lineage. HAX1 insolubility has been shown in CLPB-deficient cells, not with the dominant variants of this disorder, and one such variant (R561Q) still binds HAX1.
